ev.q: To characterize the prevalence of four healthy lifestyle characteristics (HLCs)
Prevalence of Healthy Lifestyle Characteristics --- Michigan, 1998 and 2000
Healthy weight was defined as having a body mass index between 18.5 and 25.0.
Adequate fruit and vegetable consumption was defined as eating five or more fruits and vegetables daily.
Regular LTPA was defined as at least 30 minutes of physical activity five or more times per week.
Not smoking was defined according to self-reported absence of current cigarette use
